meta.privacy.title: Privacy — Chimer
nf.p: The address may have changed, or the link is wrong. The shortcuts below cover everything the site has.
pv.p1: Chimer reads and writes the sound-scheme keys in your user registry (HKCU) and reads the audio files of the packs installed with the app. Nothing else.
pv.p2: No account, no login, no telemetry, no machine identifiers and no usage analytics. No personal data leaves your computer.
pv.p3: The only network connection is the optional update check, which queries the releases page and can be turned off in Settings. It sends no information about you or your system.
pv.p4: Backups of your previous scheme live in a folder inside your user profile. You can delete them at any time; the app never sends them off the machine.
pv.p5: Chimer is free and open source under the MIT licence. The repository shows exactly which keys are read and written.
pv.sub: Chimer is a local app. No account, no server, no usage data collected.
